about_item: Light Size: Dazzle Bright fairy lights comes with 60 LED bulbs. Bright lights exude a 360 degrees charming light, add a festival glow to your home. The fairy lights is 20 ft, bulb spacing is 3.7 inch

Remote Control: The fairy lights can be controlled with 44 key wireless remote. There are 24 different color options and 6 lighting modes (fade, dump, in waves, strobe, twinkle, breathing). It also has 3 timer modes, "4H" (4 hours on/20 hours off), "6H" (6 hours on/18 hours off), "8H" (8 hours on/16 hours off), "TIMER OFF", the timer will be canceled. Press "DIM-" and "DIM+" can adjust brightness. Press "SPEED-" and "SPEED+" can adjust speed

Battery Operated & USB: Requires 3 AA batteries for power supply, which consumes little power and can stay bright for a long time without worrying about dimming. Also the lights powered by USB normally, equipped with a USB transfer to adapter. Note: When the battery box and USB are connected , the USB power supply will be used without the battery

Waterproof: Our lights are IP44 waterproof, can withstand rain, light up well in rainy weather outside, ideal decorative light string for indoor and outdoor. Note: Please keep the USB plug and battery box away from the water
Widely Application: Creating a winter fairy kingdom belong to you with fairy lights. Perfect for indoor, home, garden, lawn, courtyards, stairs, front door, Christmas tree, fence decorations
